newsitem.title: EGYPT: Moslem militants kill five in south Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Moslem militants kill five in south Egypt.

text.p: Suspected Moslem militants shot dead four policemen and a farmer in separate incidents in southern Egypt on Wednesday, security sources said.

Gunmen believed to be members of the militant Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group) fighting to overthrow the government shot dead police sergent Kamal Youssef and his assistant Shabaan Ismail near Ashmouneen village, 300 km (200 miles) south of Cairo, the sources said.

Suspected Gama'a gunmen earlier shot dead a policeman and a farmer near the village of Tenda in Mallawi town, south of Cairo and shot dead a police auxillary when he tried to prevent them from escaping.
It was not immediately clear whether the same gunmen carried out both shootings.
Almost 1,000 people have been killed and scores wounded since Moslem militants groups launched a four-year-old battle to topple the government and transform Egypt into a strict Islamist state.
